steps.note: Open the Single Stage event creation screen.
Enable the setting that should prevent vendor additions during event creation.
Apply the requested read-only price-cap configuration.
Set the event type to RFQ and open the configuration flow.
Provide the mandatory event title using the runner's unique default.
Choose the first available RFQ template before adding products.
Add the specified product with quantity 10.
Reopen the Configuration for Event window after configuring the RFQ.
Assert that the Add Vendor control is not present while vendor addition is locked.
